description: Cryptographic dependency graph (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §6.6), A01 seed. Edge A -[type]-> B: whoever controls A can <type> B. pq is the node's own exposure to a classical-public-key break. Evidence is path:line at baseCommit; entries marked inferred were not read end to end. Owners are placeholders. Checker: scripts/crypto-graph-check.mjs.
notInModel: Physical access (plaintext /boot/identity.pem, shared VM-appliance volume key, unmeasured initramfs): see evidence-map.md §3; not a classical-crypto break.
Firmware/Secure Boot/TPM/UKI: no code exists, so no nodes; Q06 must add them.
Symmetric bearer secrets on .com (admin, read-token, inference HMAC) are PQ-neutral but single points of compromise.
